title: KV260 First Vivado Synthesis Run — RTL routes clean, bitstream blocked on I/O wrapping
drc_failure_root_cause: ising_sampler_v1.v exposes 114 S_AXI_* AXI-Lite slave ports at the top level, intending to plug into the Zynq UltraScale+ PS-PL interconnect. Without a Vivado Block Design wrapper, Vivado tried to map these as physical KV260 board pins. DRC correctly caught that two auto-placed pins (G4, W9) are grounded VRP calibration pins on the K26 SOM that cannot host logical ports. RTL is architecturally sound; what's missing is the board-integration wrapper.
retro_new_suggested_title: KV260 Ising sampler RTL lacks Block Design wrapper — bitstream not yet loadable despite clean synth+route
retro_new_suggested_fix_options: A: Add a Vivado Block Design TCL script that instantiates Zynq UltraScale+ PS + axi_interconnect + ising_sampler, connecting S_AXI internally (~100-200 LOC, canonical path)
B: Rewrite ising_sampler in C++ with Vitis HLS #pragma HLS interface s_axilite annotations, let HLS generate the wrapped IP (more effort, generates .xclbin directly)
C: Stub XDC that ignores I/O checks (would pass DRC but produce a non-loadable bitstream)
